title: True or false: Capital cities, Africa
intro: Decide whether each statement about Africa is true. Every answer shows its source.

statements.text: Cotonou is the capital of Benin.
statements.explain: Cotonou is the capital of Benin.

statements.text: Lusaka is the capital of Morocco.
statements.explain: The capital of Morocco is Rabat, not Lusaka.

statements.text: Moroni is the capital of Comoros.
statements.explain: Moroni is the capital of Comoros.

statements.text: Nouakchott is the capital of Ghana.
statements.explain: The capital of Ghana is Accra, not Nouakchott.

statements.text: Dodoma is the capital of United Republic of Tanzania.
statements.explain: Dodoma is the capital of United Republic of Tanzania.

statements.text: Kampala is the capital of Equatorial Guinea.
statements.explain: The capital of Equatorial Guinea is Malabo, not Kampala.

statements.text: Nairobi is the capital of Kenya.
statements.explain: Nairobi is the capital of Kenya.

statements.text: Monrovia is the capital of Djibouti.
statements.explain: The capital of Djibouti is Djibouti, not Monrovia.

statements.text: Mbabane is the capital of Eswatini.
statements.explain: Mbabane is the capital of Eswatini.

statements.text: Rabat is the capital of Burundi.
statements.explain: The capital of Burundi is Bujumbura, not Rabat.
